description:
### Release v3.15.1

- **Fix SoftKey Keycaps Font Binding**: Directly inject custom typeface into `SoftKeyView.q` key TextViews, resolving tofu on keys while preserving stock typography for alphanumeric/Zhuyin keys in Smart Emoji mode
- **Fix Emoji Picker & Grid Tofu**: Hook `EmojiView.h()` and canvas background worker `nts.b` TextPaint to ensure pre-rendered emoji bitmaps and fallbacks render with the custom emoji typeface
- **Fix Keyboard Lifecycle Font Loading**: Hook `SoftKeyboardView.onAttachedToWindow()` to guarantee instant runtime font application whenever the soft keyboard opens
- **Dynamic In-App Font Switch**: Eliminate `sApplied` cold-start latch so newly imported fonts and toggles take effect immediately without requiring process kill
